title: Isolation and immunofluorescence staining of Aspergillus fumigatus conidia-containing phagolysosomes
protocol: Use an inoculation loop to spread conidia on a petri dish with Aspergillus Minimal Medium agar.
Incubate conidia-plated agar plate for 5 days at 37°C.
Preheat cell culture medium stored at 4°C to 37°C in a water bath.
Seed macrophage cell line by preparing 2 × 25 cm² cell culture flasks with 3 × 10⁵ macrophages and 7 ml culture medium each.
Incubate flasks for 3 days at 37°C and 5% CO₂.
Harvest conidia 5 days after mycelial growth and sporulation on agar plates by slowly adding 10 ml of 0.9% NaCl, 0.01% Tween 20 solution to the petri dish.
Scrape the conidia from the petri dish using a T-formed spatula.
Measure concentration of conidia using a Thoma chamber or another counting method with a 1:100 dilution.
Harvest adherent macrophages with a confluency of 80%–90% by pre-warming culture medium to 37°C in water bath.
Remove the old medium from macrophages’ culture flask by aspiration.
Add 3 mL of fresh pre-warmed medium.
Use a cell scraper to scrape the macrophages from the base of the culture flask.
Collect cell suspension in a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Measure cell concentration by Thoma chamber or another counting system.
Seed cells for infection with A. fumigatus conidia.
Add 5 mL medium + 4 × 10^6 macrophages to each well of a 4-well plate (21,8 cm²/well).
Incubate cells 24 h at 37°C and 5% (v/v) CO₂.
Replace culture medium of the 4-well plate containing macrophages.
Remove the old medium.
Add 3 mL pre-warmed fresh medium to the cells.
Infect macrophages using an MOI of 5; incubate for 30 min at 4°C to synchronize phagocytosis.
Allow phagocytosis for 2 h at 37°C and 5% (v/v) CO₂.
Isolate conidia-containing phagolysosomes by the described cell lysis and Biocoll-separating process.
Pre-cool a tabletop centrifuge to 4°C.
Remove old medium of the 4 wells of the infected macrophages by aspiration.
Wash cells by adding 3 mL PBS per well and remove PBS.
Harvest cells with cell scraper in 1.5 mL PBS per well.
Transfer cell suspension from each well to a separate 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cell pellet in 1 mL homogenization buffer (250 mM sucrose, 3 mM imidazole, pH 7.4) containing protease inhibitors.
Pass the cell suspension through a 26G needle on a 1 mL syringe 20 times to lyse cells.
Check for cell breakage by adding 5 μL trypan blue to 5 μL cell suspension and observing under microscope.
Incubate each cell homogenate with 300 μL of 10 mM ATP for 15 minutes with rotation at 4°C.
Split the 1 mL homogenate into portions of 500 μL; carefully overlay each portion on top of 500 μL Biocoll (1.077 g/mL).
Centrifuge at 600 × g for 20 minutes at 4°C.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash pelleted conidia-containing phagolysosomes twice with ice-cold PBS, discarding supernatants after each centrifugation step (5 minutes, 600 × g, at 4°C).
Resuspend the pellet in 150 μL ice-cold PBS.
Seed 20 μL suspension + 1 mL PBS or place a certain amount of phagolysosomes on a coverslip in a 24-well plate and store at 4°C.
Slowly remove PBS from each well.
Add 350 μL methanol/acetone (80%/20% v/v) for fixation for 15 min at room temperature.
Wash three times with 350 μL PBS.
Remove PBS.
Add 350 μL 2% w/v BSA/PBS for blocking and staining for 1 hour.
Remove blocking solution.
Add 300 μL primary antibody diluted in blocking solutions as recommended for 1.5 hours.
Wash three times with PBS for 30 seconds each time.
Remove PBS.
Add 300 μL secondary antibody diluted in blocking solutions as recommended for 1 hour.
Wash three times with PBS for 30 seconds each time.
Mount coverslips on a glass slide with mounting medium.
